reviewFixes20260914.role: deep review of the hardening round; 4 defects found in the new changes and fixed the same day
findings: idempotency_key persisted without a time component would collide on legitimate repeat purchases and reject their PG projection: added ORDER_CLAIM_TTL_MS window bucket to the server hash (same-window retry, cross-window new order)
payment.promptpay_qr order_no path bound server total without ownership: added owns-order-or-upload-token check, falls back to client display amount
next-search placed in fail-closed scopes would 429 search during storage outages: moved to fail-open (quota still enforces when storage answers)

AUTH_SECRET prod guard in env.ts was inert (zero importers) and its first placement in auth.ts broke next build (route config collection evaluates modules): guard now lives in auth.ts with NEXT_PHASE build exemption; runtime throw plus build-phase load plus valid-secret load all proven by execution
